value.rationale: Provides a sharp, easily evaluated two-endpoint criterion for whether two equal-area moisture subregions enhance or suppress arithmetic-mean constitutive hydraulic conductivity compared with a uniform field. Classifies one possible mean reversal at every finite contrast, including cases with no reversal; relevant to constitutive aggregation and distinct from effective-medium flow.
